guest_abi: Guest pointers, fds, pthread objects, structs, handles, and errno remain 32-bit Android values. Darwin pointers never cross that boundary.
scope_of_that_sentence: The sentence is in the Guest ABI section. It constrains guest-visible values. It does not name gDvm.threadSuspendCountLock.
bionic_port_text: agr_bionic_sync says the ARM32 pthread object is one in-guest 32-bit word and that callbacks enter the shared guest address space.
plan_text: The pthread adapter section says Linux futex wait/wake is keyed by guest address and an expected 32-bit value, and that Bionic object representation is preserved.
